run_gtn_loss_example: run the pytorch GTN loss example to compute sequence criterion loss and gradients
create_target_graph: create a target graph from a token sequence where each token can align to multiple frames
compute_forward_loss: compute the forward loss by intersecting target and emission graphs and scoring them
compute_backward_gradients: compute backward gradients for each example in the batch using gtn backward
apply_gtn_loss: apply the GTNLoss function to batched inputs and targets and call backward for gradients
